results.title: Crossings
results.overview: An inspiring story of determination and the human spirit, Crossings follows 23-year-old Edo Tanas, a three-time SUP foil world champion attempting a world first: a three-day solo foiling journey across the Hawaiian archipelago. With nothing more than his board and paddle, Edo journeys more than 270 miles from Hawaiʻi Island to Kauaʻi. As he encounters dangerous channels most boats avoid and endures unpredictable winds, shifting swells, and the physical toll of returning to the water day after day, nothing is guaranteed. Preparation can get Edo to the starting line. From there, the ocean has a say. Will the conditions align? Can his body withstand three days of relentless effort? Edo sets out alone to connect the islands in an entirely new way.

results.title: Freedom Rides
results.overview: The 1965 Freedom Ride marked a turning point in the Australian civil rights movement when a group of 29 University of Sydney students, led by Charles Perkins, travelled through rural New South Wales to challenge racism and segregation against Aboriginal people. 7 of the Riders were Jewish, including future Chief Justice Jim Spigelman. Intimately observed by director Eliya Cohen, the film documents a commemorative journey in 2025, when Stand Up brought a new generation of Aboriginal and Jewish youth together to recreate the steps of the historic trip, building on the unique allyship between these remarkable communities.

results.title: 1 15 41 Tragedy to Triumph
results.overview: The University of Virginia community, and the UVA football team suffered an unthinkable tragedy in 2022. Lavel Davis Jr., Devin Chandler, and D’Sean Perry were killed in the first and only mass murder in college athletics. The remainder of the season was canceled, and the program faced an uncertain future.  Three years later, the man responsible for those murders was sentenced, forcing mothers, survivors, and teammates to confront their grief once again. Amid that emotional weight, head coach Tony Elliott and a resilient veteran group carried UVA on one of college football’s most remarkable turnarounds. With the memory of their fallen teammates guiding them every step of the way, 1 15 41 Tragedy to Triumph gives testimony to a powerful story of resilience, remembrance, healing, and hope.

results.title: One Year on the Kostiantynivka Frontline
results.original_title: One Year on the Kostiantynivka Frontline
results.overview: From the start of the battle for Kostiantynivka to the street by street combat that is still raging on, this film follows the struggle for control of the city over the span of a year. With a special focus on the experience of Ukrainian infantry in the age of drone domination, this documentary shows the new brutal reality of how the war is fought. This is done by following soldiers as they complete missions on one of the most dangerous frontlines of the entire war. As the Russian invasion approaches the heart of unoccupied Donbas, the battle for the city is vital for control of the Donetsk region, which Ukraine refuses to surrender without a fight.
